summary_1line: Duryodhana’s pleasure expedition reaches Dwaitavana, clashes with Gandharvas guarding the lake, and Karna fiercely resists as the Kuru forces prepare for battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Karna stands alone on his chariot, releasing a storm of arrows as ranks of radiant Gandharvas surge toward him in the forest.
The enchanted lake of Dwaitavana shines under flowering trees while celestial Gandharvas and Apsaras guard its entrance against approaching Kuru soldiers.
Duryodhana, surrounded by courtiers and ladies, orders pleasure houses built beside the sacred forest lake unaware it is occupied by celestial beings.
